p.src: 1  When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

en: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
u.src: 1  When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

p.src: 2  They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

en: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
u.src: 2  They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

p.src: 3  They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
u.src: 3  They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

p.src: 4  They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

en: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
u.src: 4  They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

p.src: 5  On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

en: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
u.src: 5  On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

p.src: 6  For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

en: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
u.src: 6  For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

p.src: 7  They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

en: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
u.src: 7  They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

p.src: 8  Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

en: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
u.src: 8  Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

p.src: 9  Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
u.src: 9  Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

p.src: 10  The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.

en: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.
u.src: 10  The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to the LORD their God, nor sought him, for all this.

p.src: 11  “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

en: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
u.src: 11  “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

p.src: 12  When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

en: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
u.src: 12  When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

p.src: 13  Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

en: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
u.src: 13  Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

p.src: 14  They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

en: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
u.src: 14  They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

p.src: 15  Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

en: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
u.src: 15  Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

p.src: 16  They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

en: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
